newsitem.title: USA: LaBarge says FDA clears Laser Lancet.
newsitem.headline: LaBarge says FDA clears Laser Lancet.

text.p: LaBarge Inc said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted marketing clearance to the Laser Lancet, a portable, battery-powered device for drawing blood without the use of needles.
LaBarge, along with partner Venisect Inc, said the Laser Lancet is the first and only device of its type.
The device draws blood from the patient by perforating the skin with a laser beam that makes a slit just deep enough to draw out capillary blood into a disposable plastic tube.
Venisect will market and distribute the device, which will be manufactured by LaBarge in Tulsa, Okla., they said.
They also said the U.S. Patent Office has notified Venisect that certain related patent claims will be allowed.
